title.en: A narrow kernel and a large C
title.zh: 过窄的核与过大的 C

prompt.en:
An SVM with an RBF kernel reaches 100% training accuracy but only 62% validation accuracy. The kernel is very narrow (gamma is very large) and C is very large.

Which change is most likely to help?
prompt.zh:
一个使用 RBF 核的 SVM，训练准确率达到 100%，验证准确率却只有 62%。核非常窄（gamma 非常大），C 也非常大。

下面哪个改动最可能有帮助？

text.en: Lower gamma and lower C (a wider kernel and a softer margin), and choose both by validation.
text.zh: 降低 gamma 和 C（更宽的核、更软的间隔），并用验证来选择两者。

why.en: A narrow kernel lets each training point build its own small island, and a huge C punishes every margin violation. Together they memorise the training set. Wider and softer is the cure for overfitting here.
why.zh: 很窄的核让每个训练点自成一个小岛，很大的 C 则严厉惩罚每一次间隔违反。两者合在一起就是记住了训练集。这里应该用更宽、更软的设置来对付过拟合。

text.en: Raise C further, so no training point is ever inside the margin.
text.zh: 把 C 调得更大，使任何训练点都不会落在间隔内。

why.en: Raising C pushes the model even closer to the training data. That is the direction that created the gap.
why.zh: 提高 C 会让模型更贴近训练数据，而这正是造成差距的方向。

text.en: Raise gamma, so each training point gets a sharper region of its own.
text.zh: 提高 gamma，使每个训练点拥有更尖锐的专属区域。

why.en: A larger gamma narrows the kernel even more and makes the boundary more wiggly around single points.
why.zh: 更大的 gamma 会让核更窄，决策边界围绕单个点更加曲折。

text.en: Replace the kernel by any similarity function that gives a higher training score, since a kernel only has to be symmetric.
text.zh: 换成任何能得到更高训练得分的相似度函数，因为核只要求对称。

why.en: A valid kernel must give a positive semi-definite Gram matrix for every finite set of points. Symmetry alone is not enough.
why.zh: 有效的核必须对任意有限点集都给出半正定的 Gram 矩阵，仅仅对称是不够的。

title.zh: 装袋与提升

prompt.en: Which statement correctly contrasts bagging with AdaBoost?
prompt.zh: 下面哪个说法正确地对比了装袋与 AdaBoost？

text.en: Bagging trains each model independently on a bootstrap sample and averages them, which mainly reduces variance. AdaBoost trains models one after another and gives more weight to examples that earlier models got wrong, which mainly reduces bias and can chase noisy labels.
text.zh: 装袋让每个模型在自助样本上独立训练，再把它们取平均，主要作用是降低方差。AdaBoost 依次训练模型，对之前模型做错的样本加大权重，主要作用是降低偏差，也可能去追逐有噪声的标签。

why.en: Bagging is parallel and works well with unstable learners such as deep trees. Boosting is sequential and works with weak learners. Wrong labels keep getting heavier weights, which is why noisy labels hurt boosting.
why.zh: 装袋可以并行，适合深树这类不稳定的学习器。提升是串行的，适合弱学习器。错误的标签会不断获得更高的权重，所以噪声标签对提升的危害更大。

text.en: Bagging trains models in turn and reweights the mistakes. AdaBoost trains on independent bootstrap samples.
text.zh: 装袋依次训练模型并对错误重新加权，AdaBoost 则在独立的自助样本上训练。

why.en: This swaps the two methods. Reweighting the mistakes is the defining step of boosting.
why.zh: 这把两种方法说反了。对错误重新加权正是提升的特征步骤。

text.en: Both give every model an equal vote and every training example an equal weight in every round.
text.zh: 两者都让每个模型拥有相同的投票权，每一轮中每个训练样本拥有相同的权重。

why.en: AdaBoost changes example weights each round and weights each model's vote by its accuracy. Only bagging uses equal votes.
why.zh: AdaBoost 每轮都会改变样本权重，并按准确率给每个模型的投票加权。只有装袋才使用相同的投票权。

text.en: Bagging needs weak learners that are only slightly better than guessing. AdaBoost works best with deep, unstable learners.
text.zh: 装袋需要仅比随机猜测略好的弱学习器，AdaBoost 则最适合深而不稳定的学习器。

why.en: This is reversed. Averaging many unstable deep trees is what bagging does well, and boosting is built on weak learners.
why.zh: 这是反的。对许多不稳定的深树取平均正是装袋擅长的，而提升的基础是弱学习器。

title.zh: 小型网络中的独立性

prompt.en:
A Bayesian network has four true/false variables: Rain (R) and Sprinkler (S) have no parents, Wet grass (W) has parents R and S, and Slippery path (L) has the parent W.

Which statement is correct?
prompt.zh:
一个贝叶斯网络有四个真/假变量：Rain（R）和 Sprinkler（S）没有父节点，Wet grass（W）的父节点是 R 和 S，Slippery path（L）的父节点是 W。

下面哪个说法是正确的？

text.en: R and S are independent when nothing is observed, but they become dependent once W is observed (and also once only L is observed).
text.zh: 没有任何观测时 R 和 S 相互独立，但一旦观测到 W（或者只观测到 L），它们就变得相关。

why.en: W is a collider on the path R -> W <- S. A collider blocks the path until it or one of its descendants is observed. Seeing wet grass and then learning it rained makes the sprinkler less likely (explaining away).
why.zh: W 是路径 R -> W <- S 上的汇合节点（碰撞点）。汇合节点会阻断路径，直到它或它的后代被观测到。看到草地湿了，又得知下过雨，洒水器开过的可能性就降低了（解释消除）。

text.en: R and S are dependent when nothing is observed because they share a child. Observing W makes them independent.
text.zh: 没有观测时 R 和 S 相关，因为它们有共同的孩子；观测 W 会使它们独立。

why.en: This reverses the collider rule. A shared child does not link its parents until the child (or a descendant) is observed.
why.zh: 这把汇合节点的规则说反了。共同的孩子在它（或它的后代）被观测之前，并不会把父节点联系起来。

text.en: R and L are independent when nothing is observed, because the arrow from W to L carries no information about R.
text.zh: 没有观测时 R 和 L 独立，因为从 W 指向 L 的箭头不携带关于 R 的信息。

why.en: R -> W -> L is an open chain when W is unobserved. Rain makes wet grass likely, and wet grass makes a slippery path likely.
why.zh: W 未被观测时，R -> W -> L 是一条畅通的链。下雨使草地湿的可能性变大，草地湿又使路滑的可能性变大。

text.en: Given W, R and L are still dependent, because R is an ancestor of L.
text.zh: 已知 W 时，R 和 L 仍然相关，因为 R 是 L 的祖先。

why.en: Observing W blocks the chain R -> W -> L. Given W, L depends only on W, so L is independent of R.
why.zh: 观测 W 会阻断链 R -> W -> L。已知 W 时，L 只依赖于 W，所以 L 与 R 独立。

questions.code:
R -> W <- S
W -> L

solution.en: The Markov blanket of R is its parents (none), its child W, and the child's other parent S: {W, S}. Given its blanket, R is independent of L and of every other variable.
solution.zh: R 的马尔可夫毯由它的父节点（无）、它的孩子 W，以及孩子的另一个父节点 S 组成：{W, S}。已知这个毯，R 与 L 以及所有其他变量都独立。

questions.verify_output:
R,S independent, nothing observed: True
R,S independent, W observed: False
R,S independent, only L observed: False
R,L independent, nothing observed: False
R,L independent, W observed: True

title.zh: 起始权重全部相同

prompt.en:
Noah builds a network with 2 inputs, 3 sigmoid hidden units and 1 output unit. He sets every hidden-layer weight to 0.5 and every output weight to 0.5 (all biases 0), then trains with gradient descent.

What happens?
prompt.zh:
Noah 搭建了一个网络：2 个输入、3 个 sigmoid 隐藏单元、1 个输出单元。他把隐藏层的每个权重都设为 0.5，输出层的每个权重也都设为 0.5（所有偏置为 0），然后用梯度下降训练。

会发生什么？

text.en: The three hidden units always receive identical gradients, so they stay identical. The hidden layer acts like a single unit. Small random starting weights break the symmetry.
text.zh: 三个隐藏单元每次得到的梯度都完全相同，所以它们始终保持相同。隐藏层的作用就像一个单元。较小的随机初始权重可以打破这种对称。

why.en: Each hidden unit has the same inputs, the same weights and the same output weight, so the update for each is the same. Training can still reduce the loss, but the extra units never specialise.
why.zh: 每个隐藏单元的输入、权重和输出权重都相同，所以对它们的更新也相同。训练仍然可以降低损失，但多出来的单元永远不会分工。

text.en: Training works as usual, because gradient descent will pull the three units apart after a few steps.
text.zh: 训练与平时一样进行，因为梯度下降几步之后就会把三个单元拉开。

why.en: Gradient descent moves each weight by its own gradient. Identical gradients move identical weights by the same amount, so the units never separate.
why.zh: 梯度下降按每个权重自己的梯度移动它。相同的梯度会让相同的权重移动同样的量，所以这些单元永远不会分开。

text.en: Nothing can be learned, because every gradient is exactly zero.
text.zh: 什么也学不到，因为所有梯度都恰好为零。

why.en: The gradients are not zero. They are equal across the hidden units. The loss does fall, but the network keeps only one hidden unit's worth of capacity.
why.zh: 梯度并不为零，只是各隐藏单元的梯度相等。损失确实会下降，但网络始终只有一个隐藏单元的表达能力。

text.en: A larger learning rate breaks the symmetry.
text.zh: 更大的学习率可以打破对称。

why.en: A larger step multiplies identical gradients by a larger number. The units are still identical.
why.zh: 更大的步长只是把相同的梯度乘以更大的数，这些单元仍然相同。

questions.verify_output:
hidden units still identical: True
loss fell: True

title.zh: 自动编码器学到什么

prompt.en: Which statement about autoencoders is correct?
prompt.zh: 关于自动编码器，下面哪个说法是正确的？

text.en: It is trained to reproduce its own input, so it needs no class labels. A narrow hidden layer (a bottleneck) forces it to keep only the main structure of the data.
text.zh: 它被训练去重建自己的输入，所以不需要类别标签。狭窄的隐藏层（瓶颈）迫使它只保留数据的主要结构。

why.en: The loss compares the output with the input. With fewer hidden units than inputs, the code must compress, and compression picks out the regularities.
why.zh: 损失比较的是输出与输入。隐藏单元比输入少时，编码必须压缩，而压缩会提炼出数据中的规律。

text.en: A hidden layer much wider than the input always gives better features.
text.zh: 隐藏层比输入宽得多，总能得到更好的特征。

why.en: With enough room the network can simply copy the input, which gives perfect reconstruction and no useful features. Sparsity or noise must then be added.
why.zh: 空间足够时网络可以直接复制输入，重建完美，却没有任何有用的特征。这时必须加上稀疏性约束或噪声。

text.en: A denoising autoencoder is trained to reproduce the corrupted input from the corrupted input.
text.zh: 去噪自动编码器被训练成用损坏的输入重建损坏的输入。

why.en: The input is corrupted, but the target is the clean original. That is why it learns to remove noise.
why.zh: 输入是被损坏的，但目标是干净的原始数据，因此它才会学会去除噪声。

text.en: A large reconstruction error proves that an input is an anomaly.
text.zh: 很大的重建误差就证明这个输入是异常。

why.en: It may point to novelty, but it must be checked. A harmless change can reconstruct badly, and a strange input can reconstruct well.
why.zh: 它可能提示输入是新颖的，但必须另外验证。无害的变化也可能重建得很差，而陌生的输入也可能重建得很好。

title.zh: 变异、精英保留与选择

prompt.en: Which statement about genetic algorithms is correct?
prompt.zh: 关于遗传算法，下面哪个说法是正确的？

text.en: If every individual has the same value in some position, crossover can never change that position. Only mutation can bring in a new value, so a small amount of mutation keeps the search from getting stuck.
text.zh: 如果每个个体在某个位置上的取值都相同，交叉永远无法改变这个位置。只有变异能带来新的取值，所以少量变异能避免搜索卡住。

why.en: Crossover only recombines values that already exist in the population. Diversity that has been lost can come back only through mutation.
why.zh: 交叉只是重新组合种群中已经存在的取值。已经丢失的多样性只能通过变异找回来。

text.en: Elitism (copying the best individual unchanged into the next generation) guarantees that the global optimum is found.
text.zh: 精英保留（把最好的个体原样复制到下一代）保证能找到全局最优解。

why.en: Elitism only makes sure the best solution found so far is not lost. It does not guarantee that a better one will ever be found.
why.zh: 精英保留只保证到目前为止找到的最好解不会丢失，并不保证将来一定能找到更好的解。

text.en: A higher mutation rate is always better, because it explores more.
text.zh: 变异率越高越好，因为这样探索得更多。

why.en: With very high mutation, offspring have little in common with their parents and the search becomes random. Good solutions are destroyed as fast as they are found.
why.zh: 变异率极高时，后代与父代几乎没有共同点，搜索变成随机搜索。好的解刚被找到就被破坏了。

text.en: Fitness-proportional selection always picks the fittest individual.
text.zh: 按适应度比例选择总是选出适应度最高的个体。

why.en: Each individual is chosen with probability proportional to its fitness. Weaker individuals are chosen too, which keeps some diversity.
why.zh: 每个个体被选中的概率与其适应度成正比。较弱的个体也会被选中，这样可以保留一些多样性。

title.en: Choose a method and defend it
title.zh: 选择一种方法并说明理由

prompt.en:
A small clinic wants to predict whether a patient will miss an appointment. It has 60 past appointments. Each one has 10 attributes, all nominal (for example weekday, reminder sent, room). About 15% of the attribute values are missing, scattered at random. Staff want a probability they can read, not only a yes/no answer. New appointments arrive every day, and the model must be updated in seconds, without a long training run.

Choose ONE method from: 1R, naive Bayes, k-nearest neighbours, a decision tree.
- Justify your choice with at least three facts from the description.
- Say why you reject at least two of the other methods.
- Say how you will handle zero counts and how you will test the model.
prompt.zh:
一家小诊所想预测病人是否会错过预约。它有 60 条过去的预约记录，每条有 10 个属性，全部是名义属性（例如星期几、是否发了提醒、诊室）。约 15% 的属性值缺失，随机分散。工作人员想要一个看得懂的概率，而不只是「是/否」的答案。新的预约每天都会出现，模型必须在几秒内更新，不能依赖一次很长的训练。

请从以下方法中选出一种：1R、朴素贝叶斯、k 近邻、决策树。
- 至少用描述中的三个事实来论证你的选择。
- 说明你为什么否定至少两种其他方法。
- 说明你如何处理零计数，以及如何测试这个模型。

solution.en:
Choice: naive Bayes.

Why it fits.
- Readable probabilities: it computes a score for each class. Normalising the scores gives P(miss | attributes). The values can be poorly calibrated because the attributes are not truly independent, so check them on validation data.
- Nominal attributes: it works with counts directly and needs no distance.
- Missing values: leave out any attribute whose value is missing. The other likelihoods still multiply, so no imputation is needed.
- Daily updates: the model is only a set of counts. A new appointment adds 1 to a few counts, so there is no retraining.
- Only 60 records: it estimates one small table per attribute, far fewer parameters than a tree, so it has low variance.

Why not the others.
- k-NN: there is no natural distance for nominal attributes with missing values. It keeps all records and compares at prediction time. A vote among a few neighbours gives only coarse fractions.
- Decision tree: with 60 records the splits quickly reach tiny groups, so the tree is unstable and its leaf probabilities rest on a handful of cases. Missing values need an extra policy.
- 1R: simple and an excellent baseline, but it uses one attribute only. Keep it as the baseline to beat.

Zero counts. Use add-one (Laplace) smoothing: (count + 1) / (class size + number of values of the attribute). Otherwise a single value never seen with one class sets its whole score to 0.

Testing. Use stratified cross-validation and compare with the majority-class and 1R baselines. Missed appointments are probably the minority, so report precision and recall, not only accuracy. Do not tune on the data you report on.

A different choice can be defended only if the answer also meets the needs for probabilities, missing values and quick updates, and that is hard with the other methods.
solution.zh:
选择：朴素贝叶斯。

为什么合适：
- 可读的概率：它为每个类别计算一个得分，把得分归一化就得到 P(错过 | 属性)。由于属性并非真正独立，这些值的校准可能不好，所以要在验证数据上检查。
- 名义属性：它直接用计数，不需要距离。
- 缺失值：把值缺失的属性略去即可，其余似然照常相乘，不需要填补。
- 每天更新：模型只是一组计数。一条新预约只需给几个计数加 1，不需要重新训练。
- 只有 60 条记录：它为每个属性只估计一张小表，参数比决策树少得多，所以方差低。

为什么不选其他方法：
- k 近邻：名义属性加缺失值没有自然的距离定义；它保存所有记录，在预测时才比较；几个邻居投票只能给出很粗的比例。
- 决策树：只有 60 条记录，划分很快就到了很小的分组，树不稳定，叶子上的概率只基于寥寥几个案例；缺失值还需要额外的处理策略。
- 1R：简单，是很好的基线，但它只用一个属性。应把它作为需要超越的基线。

零计数：使用加一（拉普拉斯）平滑：(计数 + 1) / (类别样本数 + 该属性的取值个数)。否则某个值只要从未和某一类同时出现过，那一类的整个得分就变成 0。

测试：使用分层交叉验证，并与多数类基线和 1R 基线比较。错过预约很可能是少数类，所以要报告精确率和召回率，而不只是准确率。不要在用来报告结果的数据上调参。

换一种选择，只有在回答同时满足概率、缺失值和快速更新这三项需求时才站得住脚，而其他方法很难做到这一点。

text.en: Chooses naive Bayes (the need for probabilities, missing values and fast updates all point to it).
text.zh: 选择朴素贝叶斯（对概率、缺失值和快速更新的需求都指向它）。

text.en: Links at least three facts from the description to properties of the method (for example probabilities, counts for nominal attributes, skipping missing values, count updates, few parameters for 60 records).
text.zh: 至少把描述中的三个事实与方法的性质联系起来（例如：概率、用计数处理名义属性、略去缺失值、计数更新、60 条记录只需很少的参数）。

text.en: Rejects at least two other methods, each with a reason tied to the facts (for example k-NN has no natural distance for nominal and missing values; a tree is unstable with 60 records; 1R uses one attribute).
text.zh: 否定至少两种其他方法，且每个理由都与描述中的事实相联系（例如：k 近邻对名义且缺失的值没有自然距离；决策树在 60 条记录上不稳定；1R 只用一个属性）。

text.en: Handles zero counts with add-one (Laplace) smoothing and says why (a zero kills the whole product).
text.zh: 用加一（拉普拉斯）平滑处理零计数，并说明原因（一个零会让整个乘积变成零）。

text.en: Gives a test plan: stratified cross-validation against majority-class or 1R baselines, with precision and recall as well as accuracy, and no tuning on the reported data.
text.zh: 给出测试方案：分层交叉验证，与多数类或 1R 基线比较，除准确率外还报告精确率和召回率，并且不在报告结果的数据上调参。

mistakes.en: Choosing a method because it is "simple" or "popular" without linking it to any fact in the description.
mistakes.zh: 仅因为方法「简单」或「流行」就选择它，而没有联系描述中的任何事实。

mistakes.en: Forgetting that one zero count wipes out a whole class score unless it is smoothed.
mistakes.zh: 忘记一个零计数会抹掉整个类别的得分，除非做平滑。

mistakes.en: Judging the model by training accuracy on 60 records.
mistakes.zh: 用 60 条记录上的训练准确率来评价模型。

title.en: Read a confusion matrix against error costs
title.zh: 结合错误代价阅读混淆矩阵

prompt.en:
A clinic screens 1,000 patients. 50 of them truly have the condition. Two screening models give these counts.

A missed case (FN) costs 20 units. A false alarm (FP) costs 1 unit. Correct decisions cost 0.

(a) Find the accuracy and the total cost of each model, and of a lazy model that always answers "healthy".
(b) Which model do you recommend? Explain why accuracy ranks them differently.
(c) With the false-alarm cost kept at 1, at what cost per missed case would your recommendation change?
prompt.zh:
一家诊所筛查了 1,000 名病人，其中 50 人真的患有该疾病。两个筛查模型给出如下计数。

漏诊一例（FN）代价 20 个单位，一次误报（FP）代价 1 个单位，判断正确的代价为 0。

(a) 求每个模型的准确率和总代价，以及一个总是回答「健康」的偷懒模型的准确率和总代价。
(b) 你推荐哪个模型？解释为什么按准确率排序会不同。
(c) 在误报代价保持为 1 的情况下，漏诊一例的代价是多少时，你的推荐会改变？

solution.en:
(a) Accuracy = (TP + TN) / 1000.
Model P: (40 + 920) / 1000 = 96.0%. Cost = 30 × 1 + 10 × 20 = 230.
Model Q: (30 + 940) / 1000 = 97.0%. Cost = 10 × 1 + 20 × 20 = 410.
Always "healthy": 950 correct = 95.0%. Cost = 50 × 20 = 1000.

(b) Recommend model P. It costs 230 against 410, even though Q has the higher accuracy. Accuracy counts every mistake as equal and is dominated by the 950 healthy patients, so even the lazy model scores 95%. The expensive mistake is the missed case, and P finds 40 of 50 (recall 0.80) while Q finds 30 of 50 (recall 0.60). Q is more precise (0.75 against 0.57), but precision matters less when a missed case is 20 times worse than a false alarm.

(c) P costs 30 + 10c and Q costs 10 + 20c, where c is the cost of a missed case. They are equal when 30 + 10c = 10 + 20c, so c = 2. If a missed case costs less than 2 false alarms, Q is cheaper and the recommendation changes. At c = 20 it is far from that point, so P is a safe choice. In practice, the costs and the decision threshold should be chosen on validation data.
solution.zh:
(a) 准确率 = (TP + TN) / 1000。
模型 P：(40 + 920) / 1000 = 96.0%。代价 = 30 × 1 + 10 × 20 = 230。
模型 Q：(30 + 940) / 1000 = 97.0%。代价 = 10 × 1 + 20 × 20 = 410。
总是回答「健康」：950 个正确 = 95.0%。代价 = 50 × 20 = 1000。

(b) 推荐模型 P。它的代价是 230，而 Q 是 410，尽管 Q 的准确率更高。准确率把每种错误都算作一样，并且被 950 名健康病人主导，所以连偷懒模型都能得 95%。代价高的错误是漏诊，P 找出了 50 人中的 40 人（召回率 0.80），Q 只找出 30 人（召回率 0.60）。Q 的精确率更高（0.75 对 0.57），但当漏诊的代价是误报的 20 倍时，精确率就没那么重要了。

(c) P 的代价是 30 + 10c，Q 的代价是 10 + 20c，其中 c 是漏诊一例的代价。当 30 + 10c = 10 + 20c 时两者相等，所以 c = 2。如果漏诊一例的代价低于 2 次误报，Q 更便宜，推荐就会改变。c = 20 离这个点很远，所以 P 是稳妥的选择。实际中，代价和决策阈值应该在验证数据上确定。

text.en: Accuracy is 96.0% for P, 97.0% for Q and 95.0% for the always-healthy model.
text.zh: 准确率：P 为 96.0%，Q 为 97.0%，总是回答「健康」的模型为 95.0%。

text.en: Costs are 230 for P (30 × 1 + 10 × 20), 410 for Q (10 × 1 + 20 × 20) and 1000 for the always-healthy model.
Recommends P because of its lower cost, although Q has the higher accuracy.

text.en: Explains why accuracy misleads: it weighs all mistakes equally and is dominated by the healthy majority. The costly error is the miss, which P reduces (recall 0.80 against 0.60).

title.en: Find the leaks in a validation setup
title.zh: 找出验证流程中的信息泄漏

prompt.en:
Mia has 200 patients. Each has 5,000 gene measurements and a label (ill or healthy). She does the following.
1. Scale every gene to mean 0 and variance 1, using all 200 patients.
2. Keep the 20 genes most correlated with the label, using all 200 patients.
3. Run 10-fold cross-validation with k-nearest neighbours for k = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 on those 20 genes.
4. Report the best cross-validation accuracy (k = 5: 94%) as the accuracy to expect on new patients.

Later she finds that 40 patients appear twice (two visits), and that the folds were drawn at random by row.

Name every leak or bias in this procedure, say why each makes the number too good, and describe a corrected procedure.
prompt.zh:
Mia 有 200 名病人，每人有 5,000 个基因测量值和一个标签（患病或健康）。她这样做：
1. 用全部 200 名病人，把每个基因缩放到均值 0、方差 1。
2. 用全部 200 名病人，保留与标签相关性最高的 20 个基因。
3. 在这 20 个基因上，对 k = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 做 10 折交叉验证的 k 近邻。
4. 把最好的交叉验证准确率（k = 5：94%）作为新病人上应预期的准确率报告。

后来她发现有 40 名病人出现了两次（两次就诊），并且折是按行随机划分的。

请指出这个流程中的每一处泄漏或偏差，说明各自为什么使结果偏好，并描述修正后的流程。

solution.en:
Leaks and biases.
1. Gene selection used all labels. This is the main leak. With 5,000 genes and only 200 patients, some genes correlate with the label by chance. Choosing them with the validation patients' labels in view makes the validation folds look easy. On pure noise, this kind of procedure can still report accuracy far above 50%.
2. Scaling used all patients. A smaller leak of the same kind: the mean and variance were computed with the validation rows included. It uses no labels, but the model has still seen the validation features.
3. Repeated patients across folds. A patient with two visits can have one visit in training and one in validation. The model can recognise the person rather than the illness.
4. Picking the best k and reporting its score. The best of five scores is partly luck, and the same data chose k and judged it, so 94% is optimistic.

Corrected procedure.
- Set aside a final test set of patients first, and never touch it until the end.
- Split by patient (group folds), so all visits of one person stay on one side.
- Inside every training fold, fit the scaler, select the genes and fit the model using only that fold's training patients, then apply them to the validation patients. Choose k with an inner loop (nested cross-validation) or a separate validation set.
- Report the score once, on the untouched test patients (or the outer-loop average of nested CV).

A small simulation on random labels, with the selection done on all data or inside each fold, shows the size of the first leak.
solution.zh:
泄漏与偏差：
1. 基因选择用了所有标签。这是最主要的泄漏。5,000 个基因而只有 200 名病人，总有一些基因碰巧与标签相关。在能看到验证病人标签的情况下挑选基因，会让验证折显得很容易。即使数据只是纯噪声，这类流程也可能报告出远高于 50% 的准确率。
2. 缩放用了全部病人。这是同类的较小泄漏：均值和方差把验证行也算了进去。它没有用到标签，但模型仍然见过验证数据的特征。
3. 同一个病人出现在不同的折里。有两次就诊的病人，可能一次在训练折、一次在验证折。模型可以认出这个人，而不是认出这种疾病。
4. 挑出最好的 k 并报告它的分数。五个分数中的最高值有一部分是运气，而且同一批数据既用来选 k，又用来评价它，所以 94% 偏乐观。

修正后的流程：
- 先留出一个最终测试集（按病人留出），到最后才使用。
- 按病人分组划分折（分组折叠），同一个人的所有就诊都留在同一边。
- 在每个训练折内部，只用该折的训练病人拟合缩放器、选择基因并训练模型，再把它们应用到验证病人上。用内层循环（嵌套交叉验证）或另外的验证集来选择 k。
- 只在未动过的测试病人上报告一次分数（或报告嵌套交叉验证外层循环的平均值）。

用随机标签做一个小模拟，分别在全部数据上和在每一折内部做基因选择，就能看出第一种泄漏的大小。

text.en: Names gene selection on all patients as the main leak: validation labels influenced which genes were kept, and with 5,000 genes some correlate with the label by chance.
text.zh: 指出在全部病人上选基因是主要泄漏：验证病人的标签影响了保留哪些基因，而 5,000 个基因里总有一些碰巧与标签相关。

text.en: Names scaling fitted on all patients, validation rows included, as a smaller leak of the same kind.
text.zh: 指出用全部病人（包含验证行）拟合缩放是同类的较小泄漏。

text.en: Names the repeated patients across random folds and fixes it with folds grouped by patient.
text.zh: 指出同一病人出现在随机划分的不同折里，并用按病人分组的折来修正。

text.en: Names selection bias from picking the best k and reporting the same score, and fixes it with nested cross-validation or a separate untouched test set.
text.zh: 指出挑选最好的 k 并报告同一个分数会带来选择偏差，并用嵌套交叉验证或另外一个未动过的测试集来修正。

text.en: Gives a corrected order: split first, then fit scaling, gene selection and the model inside each training fold only, and report once on untouched data.
text.zh: 给出修正后的顺序：先划分，然后只在每个训练折内部拟合缩放、基因选择和模型，并只在未动过的数据上报告一次。

mistakes.en: Saying "use more folds" as the fix. The number of folds does not remove a leak.
mistakes.zh: 把「增加折数」当作修正办法。折数再多也消除不了泄漏。

mistakes.en: Treating scaling as harmless because it uses no labels. It still lets validation rows influence the training step.
mistakes.zh: 认为缩放不使用标签所以无害。它仍然让验证行影响了训练步骤。

mistakes.en: Mentioning only the duplicated patients and missing the feature-selection leak.
mistakes.zh: 只提到重复的病人，而漏掉特征选择的泄漏。

questions.verify_code:
import random

r = random.Random(2)
n, p, top = 100, 2000, 10
X = [[r.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(p)] for _ in range(n)]
y = [r.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]


def select(idx):
    ys = [y[i] for i in idx]
    my = sum(ys) / len(ys)
    scores = []
    for j in range(p):
        col = [X[i][j] for i in idx]
        mc = sum(col) / len(col)
        scores.append((abs(sum((a - mc) * (b - my) for a, b in zip(col, ys))), j))
    scores.sort(reverse=True)
    return [j for _, j in scores[:top]]


def correct(train, test, feats):
    ok = 0
    for i in test:
        near = sorted((sum((X[i][j] - X[t][j]) ** 2 for j in feats), y[t]) for t in train)[:3]
        ok += (sum(lab for _, lab in near) >= 2) == (y[i] == 1)
    return ok


folds = [list(range(f, n, 10)) for f in range(10)]
leaky_feats = select(list(range(n)))
leaky = honest = 0
for f in folds:
    train = [i for i in range(n) if i not in f]
    leaky += correct(train, f, leaky_feats)
    honest += correct(train, f, select(train))
print('labels are random noise')
print('selection on all data gives CV accuracy above 0.7:', leaky / n > 0.7)
print('selection inside each fold gives CV accuracy below 0.6:', honest / n < 0.6)

title.en: Why this heuristic is not admissible
title.zh: 为什么这个启发式不可采纳

prompt.en:
One-way roads: S -> A costs 1, A -> G costs 3, S -> B costs 2, B -> G costs 3. The heuristic is h(S) = 3, h(A) = 6, h(B) = 3, h(G) = 0.

(a) Show that h is not admissible and say for which node.
(b) Run A* as a tree search (priority f = g + h; test the goal when a node is removed). List the nodes in the order they are removed, with their f values.
(c) What route does A* return? Is it optimal?
(d) In two sentences, explain why the overestimate caused this.
(e) What is the largest value of h(A) that keeps h admissible, and what does A* do then?
prompt.zh:
单行道：S -> A 费用 1，A -> G 费用 3，S -> B 费用 2，B -> G 费用 3。启发式为 h(S) = 3，h(A) = 6，h(B) = 3，h(G) = 0。

(a) 证明 h 不是可采纳的，并指出是哪个节点。
(b) 以树搜索的方式运行 A*（优先级 f = g + h；节点被移出时才检查目标）。按移出的先后顺序列出节点及其 f 值。
(c) A* 返回哪条路线？它是最优的吗？
(d) 用两句话解释为什么高估导致了这个结果。
(e) 保持 h 可采纳时，h(A) 最大能取多少？此时 A* 的行为是什么？

solution.en:
(a) The true cheapest cost to G is h*(A) = 3, h*(B) = 3 and h*(S) = 4 (through A). The estimates h(S) = 3 and h(B) = 3 are fine, but h(A) = 6 > h*(A) = 3. Node A is the one that overestimates, so h is not admissible.

(b) Remove S (f = 0 + 3 = 3). Add A with g = 1, f = 1 + 6 = 7, and B with g = 2, f = 2 + 3 = 5. Remove B (f = 5), the smaller one. Add G with g = 5, f = 5. Now G (f = 5) beats A (f = 7), so remove G. Order: S (3), B (5), G (5).

(c) A* returns S -> B -> G with cost 5. It is not optimal: S -> A -> G costs 1 + 3 = 4.

(d) A* trusts f as a lower bound on the cost of any route through a node. Here f(A) = 7 overstates the true cost 4 of the route through A, so the better branch looks worse than the goal found through B, and A* stops before looking at it.

(e) h(A) must be at most h*(A) = 3. With h(A) = 3, f(A) = 1 + 3 = 4, which is below f(B) = 5, so A is removed second. Then G is reached with g = 4, f = 4, and it is removed before B. A* returns S -> A -> G with the optimal cost 4.
solution.zh:
(a) 到 G 的真实最小代价是：h*(A) = 3，h*(B) = 3，h*(S) = 4（经过 A）。估计 h(S) = 3 和 h(B) = 3 没问题，但 h(A) = 6 > h*(A) = 3。节点 A 高估了，所以 h 不是可采纳的。

(b) 移出 S（f = 0 + 3 = 3）。加入 A：g = 1，f = 1 + 6 = 7；加入 B：g = 2，f = 2 + 3 = 5。移出 f 较小的 B（f = 5）。加入 G：g = 5，f = 5。此时 G（f = 5）比 A（f = 7）更小，于是移出 G。顺序：S (3)、B (5)、G (5)。

(c) A* 返回 S -> B -> G，费用 5。它不是最优的：S -> A -> G 的费用是 1 + 3 = 4。

(d) A* 相信 f 是经过某个节点的任何路线的代价下界。这里 f(A) = 7 高估了经过 A 的路线的真实代价 4，于是更好的分支看起来比经过 B 找到的目标还差，A* 在检查它之前就停了。

(e) h(A) 最大不能超过 h*(A) = 3。取 h(A) = 3 时，f(A) = 1 + 3 = 4，小于 f(B) = 5，所以 A 第二个被移出。然后到达 G：g = 4，f = 4，它先于 B 被移出。A* 返回 S -> A -> G，费用 4，是最优的。

text.en: Identifies node A: h(A) = 6 is larger than its true remaining cost 3.
text.zh: 指出节点 A：h(A) = 6 大于它真实的剩余代价 3。

text.en: Computes f(A) = 7 and f(B) = 5 and gives the removal order S, B, G (G removed with f = 5).
text.zh: 算出 f(A) = 7 和 f(B) = 5，并给出移出顺序 S、B、G（G 以 f = 5 被移出）。

text.en: States that A* returns S -> B -> G with cost 5, which is not optimal because S -> A -> G costs 4.
text.zh: 指出 A* 返回费用为 5 的 S -> B -> G，它不是最优的，因为 S -> A -> G 的费用是 4。

text.en: Explains that f(A) = 7 overstates the cost of every route through A, so the better branch was never expanded; A* is optimal only when f is a lower bound.
text.zh: 解释 f(A) = 7 高估了所有经过 A 的路线的代价，所以更好的分支从未被展开；只有当 f 是下界时 A* 才是最优的。

text.en: Gives h(A) <= 3 and shows that with h(A) = 3 the node A is removed before B (f = 4 < 5) and the cost 4 route is returned.
text.zh: 给出 h(A) <= 3，并说明 h(A) = 3 时节点 A 先于 B 被移出（f = 4 < 5），返回费用为 4 的路线。

mistakes.en: Checking admissibility on h(S) or h(B) only, and not on every node.
mistakes.zh: 只检查 h(S) 或 h(B) 的可采纳性，而没有检查每一个节点。

mistakes.en: Testing for the goal when a node is added to the frontier instead of when it is removed.
mistakes.zh: 在节点加入前沿时就检查目标，而不是在节点被移出时检查。

mistakes.en: Believing that A* is optimal for any heuristic that "points toward the goal".
mistakes.zh: 以为只要启发式「指向目标」，A* 就是最优的。

title.zh: 四个点上的间隔几何

prompt.en:
Four training points lie in the plane.
Positive class (y = +1): (2, 2) and (3, 3).
Negative class (y = -1): (0, 0) and (-1, 1).

Find the hard-margin linear SVM: the line w . x + b = 0 with the widest empty strip, where y (w . x + b) >= 1 for every point.

(a) Find w and b. Hint: the widest strip is set by the closest pair of points from opposite classes, and w points along the line joining them.
(b) What is the margin width 2 / ||w||?
(c) Which points are support vectors?
(d) What does the model predict for (1, 2)? Is that point inside the margin strip?
(e) What changes if the point (3, 3) is deleted? What changes if (0, 0) is deleted?
prompt.zh:
平面上有四个训练点。
正类（y = +1）：(2, 2) 和 (3, 3)。
负类（y = -1）：(0, 0) 和 (-1, 1)。

求硬间隔线性 SVM：即空白带最宽的直线 w . x + b = 0，要求每个点都满足 y (w . x + b) >= 1。

(a) 求 w 和 b。提示：最宽的带由相距最近的一对异类点决定，w 沿着连接它们的直线方向。
(b) 间隔宽度 2 / ||w|| 是多少？
(c) 哪些点是支持向量？
(d) 模型对 (1, 2) 的预测是什么？这个点在间隔带内吗？
(e) 删去点 (3, 3) 会怎样？删去点 (0, 0) 会怎样？

solution.en:
(a) The closest pair of opposite points is (2, 2) and (0, 0), at distance sqrt 8 = 2.83. The other negative point (-1, 1) is farther from (2, 2), and (3, 3) is farther from (0, 0). So w points along d = (2, 2) - (0, 0) = (2, 2).
If x+ and x- sit exactly on the two margin lines, w . x+ + b = 1 and w . x- + b = -1, so w . (x+ - x-) = 2. With w parallel to d, w = 2 d / ||d||^2 = 2 (2, 2) / 8 = (0.5, 0.5). Then b = 1 - w . (2, 2) = 1 - 2 = -1.
Check: (2, 2) gives 0.5 × 4 - 1 = 1. (0, 0) gives -1, so y f = 1. (-1, 1) gives -0.5 + 0.5 - 1 = -1, so y f = 1. (3, 3) gives 3 - 1 = 2, so y f = 2 (comfortably outside).

(b) ||w|| = sqrt(0.25 + 0.25) = 0.707, so the width is 2 / 0.707 = 2.83. It equals the distance between (2, 2) and (0, 0), as it should.

(c) Support vectors are the points with y f = 1: (2, 2), (0, 0) and also (-1, 1), which lies exactly on the negative margin line. (3, 3) is not a support vector.

(d) f(1, 2) = 0.5 + 1 - 1 = 0.5 > 0, so the prediction is positive. Since |f| < 1, the point lies inside the margin strip. That is allowed for a new point; the margin conditions are only demanded of the training data.

(e) Deleting (3, 3) changes nothing: it is not a support vector, and the same w and b still satisfy all the constraints with the same widest strip.
Deleting (0, 0) changes the solution. Now the closest opposite pair is (2, 2) and (-1, 1), with d = (3, 1) and ||d||^2 = 10. So w = 2 (3, 1) / 10 = (0.6, 0.2) and b = 1 - w . (2, 2) = -0.6. Check (3, 3): 1.8 + 0.6 - 0.6 = 1.8 >= 1. The width is 2 / sqrt 0.4 = 3.16, wider than before. The boundary rotates, because (0, 0) was a support vector.
solution.zh:
(a) 最近的一对异类点是 (2, 2) 和 (0, 0)，距离 sqrt 8 = 2.83。另一个负类点 (-1, 1) 离 (2, 2) 更远，(3, 3) 离 (0, 0) 更远。所以 w 沿着 d = (2, 2) - (0, 0) = (2, 2) 的方向。
如果 x+ 和 x- 恰好在两条间隔线上，则 w . x+ + b = 1，w . x- + b = -1，所以 w . (x+ - x-) = 2。w 与 d 平行，因此 w = 2 d / ||d||^2 = 2 (2, 2) / 8 = (0.5, 0.5)。再由 b = 1 - w . (2, 2) = 1 - 2 = -1。
检查：(2, 2) 得 0.5 × 4 - 1 = 1。(0, 0) 得 -1，所以 y f = 1。(-1, 1) 得 -0.5 + 0.5 - 1 = -1，所以 y f = 1。(3, 3) 得 3 - 1 = 2，所以 y f = 2（远在间隔之外）。

(b) ||w|| = sqrt(0.25 + 0.25) = 0.707，所以宽度是 2 / 0.707 = 2.83，等于 (2, 2) 与 (0, 0) 之间的距离，这正是应有的结果。

(c) 支持向量是 y f = 1 的点：(2, 2)、(0, 0)，以及恰好落在负类间隔线上的 (-1, 1)。(3, 3) 不是支持向量。

(d) f(1, 2) = 0.5 + 1 - 1 = 0.5 > 0，所以预测为正类。因为 |f| < 1，这个点位于间隔带内。对新点来说这是允许的，间隔条件只要求训练数据满足。

(e) 删去 (3, 3) 什么都不变：它不是支持向量，同样的 w 和 b 仍然满足所有约束，最宽的带也不变。
删去 (0, 0) 会改变解。此时最近的异类点对是 (2, 2) 和 (-1, 1)，d = (3, 1)，||d||^2 = 10。所以 w = 2 (3, 1) / 10 = (0.6, 0.2)，b = 1 - w . (2, 2) = -0.6。检查 (3, 3)：1.8 + 0.6 - 0.6 = 1.8 >= 1。宽度是 2 / sqrt 0.4 = 3.16，比之前更宽。边界发生了旋转，因为 (0, 0) 原本是支持向量。

text.en: Finds the closest opposite-class pair, (2, 2) and (0, 0), and takes w along the line joining them (direction (1, 1)).
text.zh: 找出最近的异类点对 (2, 2) 和 (0, 0)，并让 w 沿着连接它们的直线方向（方向 (1, 1)）。

text.en: Gets w = (0.5, 0.5) and b = -1 and checks y (w . x + b) = 1 at the support vectors.
text.zh: 得到 w = (0.5, 0.5) 和 b = -1，并在支持向量上检验 y (w . x + b) = 1。

text.en: Gives the margin width 2 / ||w|| = 2.83 (not 1 / ||w||).
Lists the support vectors (2, 2), (0, 0) and (-1, 1), and says (3, 3) is not one because y f = 2.
text.zh: 列出支持向量 (2, 2)、(0, 0) 和 (-1, 1)，并说明 (3, 3) 不是，因为它的 y f = 2。

text.en: Predicts positive for (1, 2) with f = 0.5 and notes that it lies inside the margin strip.
text.zh: 预测 (1, 2) 为正类，f = 0.5，并指出它位于间隔带内。

text.en: Says deleting (3, 3) changes nothing, and deleting the support vector (0, 0) changes the boundary (to w = (0.6, 0.2), b = -0.6, with a wider margin).
text.zh: 指出删去 (3, 3) 没有影响，而删去支持向量 (0, 0) 会改变边界（变为 w = (0.6, 0.2)，b = -0.6，间隔更宽）。

mistakes.en: Using (3, 3) as a support vector because it is positive and far from the negatives.
mistakes.zh: 因为 (3, 3) 是正类且离负类很远，就把它当作支持向量。

mistakes.en: Stopping at the closest pair and missing that (-1, 1) also lies exactly on the margin line.
mistakes.zh: 只考虑最近的一对点，没发现 (-1, 1) 也恰好在间隔线上。

def solve(pos, neg):
    best = (-1.0, None, 0.0)
    for k in range(36000):
